prompt: At the shelter, the woman asked (our house / to have) a closed garden.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос в косвенной речи вводится через if или whether с прямым порядком слов. После asked время сдвигается в прошлое: have → had.

prompt: A tourist in Helsinki asked ___ from platform three.
options: did the harbour train leave
if did the harbour train leave
if the harbour train left
the harbour train left
explanation_ru: Косвенный общий вопрос требует союза if/whether и прямого порядка слов без вспомогательного did. Частая ошибка — сохранять did или пропускать if.

prompt: Ten minutes before the second act in Vienna, Lukas could not find his costume. He asked the dresser (his grey coat / to be) ready for the scene. She held up the wrong sleeve with a worried frown and asked why (one sleeve / to look) so loose. Suddenly, the director knocked and wanted to know (he / can / to go) on stage without a jacket.
explanation_ru: В общих вопросах добавляем if/whether, в специальном вопросе после why сохраняем прямой порядок слов без did. В прошедшем рассказе глаголы сдвигаются: is → was, looks → looked, can → could.

prompt: During the cooking class, a tourist asked if did that sauce have chocolate.
answer: During the cooking class, a tourist asked if that sauce had chocolate.
accepted_answers: During the cooking class, a tourist asked if that sauce had chocolate.
During the cooking class, a tourist asked whether that sauce had chocolate.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить did после if в косвенном вопросе. Вместо этого используется прямой порядок слов и прошедшая форма смыслового глагола (had).

prompt: Finding a strange bicycle chained to her gate in Marseille, Mireille stopped a passing officer and asked (someone / to report) a stolen bike that morning.
explanation_ru: Вопрос о событии, случившемся до момента речи (Has someone reported / Did someone report...?), в косвенной речи переходит в Past Perfect (had reported) с союзом if или whether.

prompt: My grandmother asked me, "Did you remember to feed the small grey cat?" → My grandmother asked me …
answer: My grandmother asked me if I had remembered to feed the small grey cat.
accepted_answers: My grandmother asked me if I had remembered to feed the small grey cat.
My grandmother asked me whether I had remembered to feed the small grey cat.
My grandmother asked me if I'd remembered to feed the small grey cat.
My grandmother asked me whether I'd remembered to feed the small grey cat.
My grandmother asked me if I remembered to feed the small grey cat.
My grandmother asked me whether I remembered to feed the small grey cat.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос передаётся через if/whether без did и знака вопроса, а you меняется на I. Past Simple в прямой речи сдвигается в Past Perfect (или может остаться в Past Simple).

prompt: Karin looked at her plate and asked (her pie / to be) baked or fried.
explanation_ru: Для вопроса с выбором (or) естественно использовать whether (допустимо и if), а подлежащее her pie ставить перед глаголом was.

prompt: Everyone laughed by the snack table in Accra. Kwame asked Ama (she / ever / to dance) on a table before.
explanation_ru: Прямой вопрос в Present Perfect (Have you ever danced...?) после глагола asked переходит в Past Perfect (had ever danced) с прямым порядком слов после if/whether.

prompt: Ciaran sat nervously in the school nurse's office in Dublin and said, "Does the flu injection hurt?"
options: Ciaran told the nurse that the flu injection did not hurt.
Ciaran asked the nurse if the flu injection hurt.
Ciaran asked the nurse if did the flu injection hurt.
Ciaran asked the nurse to give him the flu injection.
explanation_ru: Прямой общий вопрос передаётся глаголом asked с союзом if и прямым порядком слов без did; форма глагола hurt в Past Simple совпадает с начальной. Остальные варианты искажают смысл или содержат лишний did.

prompt: Beside the glass case in Cairo, Tariq asked the librarian (that blue vase / really / to belong) to a queen.

blanks.cue: that blue vase / really / to belong
blanks.answer: if that blue vase had really belonged
accepted_answers: if that blue vase had really belonged
whether that blue vase had really belonged
if that blue vase really belonged
whether that blue vase really belonged
if that blue vase really had belonged
whether that blue vase really had belonged

explanation_ru: После asked общий вопрос вводится через if/whether без вспомогательного did. Вопрос о прошлом (Did it belong...?) переходит в Past Perfect (had really belonged) или сохраняет Past Simple.

prompt: Heavy rain had fallen all night at our mountain lodge in Nepal. Over breakfast, I asked the owner (we / can / to walk) along the mountain path. She shook her head, explained that the bridge was not safe, and asked where (we / to want) to head instead. Before leaving the table, my friend asked how long (bad weather / usually / to last) in that valley.
explanation_ru: В первом пробеле общий вопрос сдвигается из can в could после if/whether. Во втором и третьем после where и how long нужен прямой порядок слов; для обычного природного явления допустимы и lasted, и last.

prompt: Midway through a restaurant interview in Rome, Marco asked (they / to open) on Sundays, and the owner asked why (he / to care) so soon.
explanation_ru: Первый вопрос — общий (if/whether + прямой порядок слов; для расписания допустимо и open, и opened). Второй — специальный после why без did и с обязательным сдвигом cared.

prompt: At a photo show, a visitor asked whether the fisherman's picture was for sale.
answer: At a photo show, a visitor asked whether the fisherman's picture was for sale.
accepted_answers: At a photo show, a visitor asked whether the fisherman's picture was for sale.
explanation_ru: В этом предложении нет ошибки: использован союз whether, прямой порядок слов (the fisherman's picture was) и правильный сдвиг времени в прошлое.

prompt: Before Friday's band practice in Tokyo, Kenji sent a quick message to the drummer. He wanted to know (Haruto / still / to have) the song list for Saturday's show. Because the hall was quiet, Kenji also asked why (their studio / not / to open) until seven. Soon after, Haruto replied with a photo of his notebook and asked when (they / will / to practise) the last track. Kenji laughed because he could not read a single word.
explanation_ru: В первом пробеле общий вопрос передаётся через if/whether + had. Во втором отрицание в Past Simple сохраняет did not, но стоит после подлежащего; в третьем will сдвигается в would.

prompt: In our science class, Petr asked ___ the white salt.
options: could we taste
if could we taste
if we can taste
if we could taste
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе нужен союз if, прямой порядок слов (we could) и сдвиг модального глагола can → could. Ошибочные варианты нарушают порядок слов или забывают про сдвиг.

prompt: On a boat off Iceland, Astrid asked the captain, "Can we stay out here until the whales come back?" → On a boat off Iceland, Astrid asked the captain …
answer: On a boat off Iceland, Astrid asked the captain if they could stay out there until the whales came back.
accepted_answers: On a boat off Iceland, Astrid asked the captain if they could stay out there until the whales came back.
On a boat off Iceland, Astrid asked the captain whether they could stay out there until the whales came back.
explanation_ru: При переводе в косвенную речь добавляется if/whether, меняется порядок слов, а также сдвигаются местоимение (we → they), слово места (here → there) и глаголы (can → could, come → came).

prompt: The seller only smiled when I asked (those tomatoes / to come) from a farm.
explanation_ru: После asked общий вопрос вводится союзом if или whether, без вспомогательного do/did, а глагол come переходит в прошедшее время came.

prompt: I crossed the Athens marathon finish line completely soaked in sweat. When a reporter asked how (I / to keep) going in such fierce heat, I grinned and pointed at my cheering children.
explanation_ru: В специальном вопросе после how используется прямой порядок слов без did. Поскольку забег уже завершился до вопроса, Past Simple переходит в Past Perfect (I had kept), хотя допустимо и I kept.

prompt: While testing a new phone in Jakarta, Budi asked the shop assistant ___ two full days.
options: whether the battery could last
whether could the battery last
could the battery last
that the battery could last
explanation_ru: Для косвенного общего вопроса нужны союз whether/if и прямой порядок слов (the battery could last). Частая ошибка — ставить that вместо whether или выносить could перед подлежащим.

prompt: Lost at a busy Greek port, Elena hurried up to a ferry captain with a postcard in her hand. She asked him (that ferry / to go) to the island with the blue church. The captain laughed and wondered which island (she / to mean), because seven nearby islands had blue churches. Blushing, Elena showed him her ticket and asked, "Could you tell me when (boarding / to start) for the right one?"
explanation_ru: В первых двух пробелах после asked и wondered время сдвигается (went, meant) при прямом порядке слов. В вежливом встроенном вопросе Could you tell me when... сдвига времени нет, но порядок слов всё равно прямой (boarding starts).

prompt: In a Barcelona canteen, Sofia asked where could she find the faculty office, and the cashier pointed to the wrong building.
answer: In a Barcelona canteen, Sofia asked where she could find the faculty office, and the cashier pointed to the wrong building.
accepted_answers: In a Barcelona canteen, Sofia asked where she could find the faculty office, and the cashier pointed to the wrong building.
explanation_ru: Частая ошибка — сохранять вопросительный порядок слов (where could she) после вопросительного слова. В косвенном вопросе подлежащее всегда стоит перед модальным глаголом: where she could find.

prompt: Looking nervously at the rising river in northern Thailand, I asked our guide (heavy rain / usually / to flood) the lower tents. He smiled calmly and moved my bag to higher ground.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос вводится через if/whether с прямым порядком слов. После asked обычно используется сдвиг flooded, но поскольку речь идёт о повторяющемся природном явлении, допустимо и floods.

prompt: On my first morning in our Sydney office, the new accountant could not get online and walked over to my desk. He politely asked (anyone / to know) the Wi-Fi password. Immediately, three colleagues shouted completely different words across the room. Laughing, our manager came out of her office and asked why (everyone / to shout) passwords at nine o'clock.
explanation_ru: В первом пробеле общий вопрос вводится через if/whether и переходит в Past Simple (knew). Во втором вопрос о действии в тот момент (Why is everyone shouting?) сдвигается в Past Continuous с прямым порядком слов.

prompt: Mei watched a green parrot and asked (the bird / to know) three languages.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос в косвенной речи требует союза if/whether и прямого порядка слов без does. После asked глагол know переходит в прошедшую форму knew.

prompt: Inside a Paris metro station, an angry passenger asked the worker why (no ticket / to appear) after the machine took his coins.
explanation_ru: После вопросительного слова why сохраняется прямой порядок слов без did. Событие произошло до вопроса, поэтому используется Past Perfect (had appeared) или Past Simple (appeared).

prompt: After sniffing a glass jar at a Marrakesh market, Omar asked the spice seller ___ for a pot of rice, and the man silently held up a tiny brass spoon.
options: how much saffron did he need
how much saffron he needed
how much saffron needed he
if how much saffron he needed
explanation_ru: В специальном косвенном вопросе после how much saffron идёт прямой порядок слов (he needed) без did и без лишнего союза if. Остальные варианты содержат типичные ошибки инверсии или дублирования союзов.

prompt: During a live video call at a Houston space museum, ten-year-old Leo waved excitedly at the screen. First, he asked the astronaut how (crews / to sleep) while the station travelled so fast. The astronaut laughed and explained that sleeping bags were strapped to the wall. Then Leo's sister stepped up to the microphone and asked (floating food / ever / to hit) the buttons, before politely adding, "Could you tell us what (space / to smell) like?"
explanation_ru: В первых двух пробелах после asked нужен прямой порядок слов без do/does (для постоянных фактов допустимы и прошедшая, и настоящая форма). В вежливом встроенном вопросе Could you tell us what... глагол остаётся в Present Simple без инверсии.

prompt: Between takes in an Italian square, the director asked me (I / to prefer) standing by the fountain with a newspaper.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос передаётся с помощью if или whether и прямого порядка слов. После глагола asked форма prefer сдвигается в Past Simple (preferred).

prompt: At my sister's wedding, a guest asked who (to bake) the tall blue cake.
explanation_ru: В вопросе к подлежащему (who) вспомогательный did не нужен ни в прямой, ни в косвенной речи. Поскольку торт испекли раньше, используется had baked (или baked).

prompt: Halfway through a first-aid class in Bogotá, Camila raised her hand and asked the trainer how long should a cold pack stay on a sore arm.
answer: Halfway through a first-aid class in Bogotá, Camila raised her hand and asked the trainer how long a cold pack should stay on a sore arm.
accepted_answers: Halfway through a first-aid class in Bogotá, Camila raised her hand and asked the trainer how long a cold pack should stay on a sore arm.
explanation_ru: Ошибка заключается в вопросительном порядке слов (should a cold pack stay). В косвенном вопросе после how long подлежащее должно идти перед модальным глаголом should, который сам по себе не меняется.

prompt: When we walked into a lively jazz club in New Orleans, the waiter smiled and said, "Would you like seats right by the stage, or do you prefer a quieter table near the window?"
options: The waiter asked us did we want seats near the stage or a quieter table by the window.
The waiter told us to take seats near the stage instead of a quieter table by the window.
The waiter wondered why we preferred seats near the stage to a quieter table by the window.
The waiter asked us whether we wanted seats near the stage or preferred a quieter table by the window.
explanation_ru: Выбор из двух вариантов передаётся через asked us whether с прямым порядком слов и сдвигом времён (wanted / preferred). Первый вариант содержит ошибку с did, а второй и третий меняют смысл исходной реплики.

prompt: Visiting a botanical research garden in Singapore, Nadia leaned closely over a dark tropical flower that looked almost black. Surprised by its rich scent, she asked the scientist why (it / to smell) like chocolate only after sunset. The scientist smiled and explained that night insects preferred sweet smells in the dark. Intrigued, Nadia also wondered (the shop / to sell) seeds of that plant, before politely asking, "Could you tell me where (this flower / to grow) in the wild?"
explanation_ru: В первых двух пробелах после asked и wondered используется прямой порядок слов (для научных и действующих фактов возможен как сдвиг, так и Present Simple). В третьем пробеле встроенный вопрос Could you tell me where... требует прямого порядка слов без does.

prompt: Checking us into the beach hotel, the receptionist asked ___ baby turtles that night.
options: did our children want to see
if did our children want to see
whether our children wanted to see
that our children wanted to see
explanation_ru: Косвенный общий вопрос требует союза whether/if и прямого порядка слов с глаголом в Past Simple (wanted). Частые ошибки — ставить that вместо whether или оставлять вспомогательный did.
